scope: Independent review of executor artifacts and observed operations, not intended author behavior.

requirements.criterion: Question, object and conditions match the actual task; no invented goal, scope, historical output or facts.
Decision-critical implementation claims follow actual relevant source and connected conditions; documentation alone is not implementation verification.
Method and inspected sources fit the question; observed runtime, source inference, reported claims and unknowns remain distinct.
The decision follows the evidence with bounded limitations; no test exit or file existence substituted for a substantive result.
Written research records use question-based paths, required flat metadata, working relative references, preserved conditions and creation dates; explicit no-write wins.
If a diagram helps or is requested, it preserves source branches and semantics; critical relations map to evidence, statuses and relation meanings are explicit; causal hypotheses are not facts.
Simple questions need no Mermaid or empty structural placeholder. Findings/evidence stay understandable as text.
Actual evidence and saved artifacts were inspected before completion claims; parser/render scope is reported truthfully and is separate from factual validity.
Execution respects input immutability, data boundaries and prohibitions on install, publication, commits and unrequested external communication.

domain_bar: Accurate control/data flow and source semantics, no fabricated provenance/results or missing material exceptions; distinguish missing evidence from evidence of absence.
guardrails: Read source and complete observed command/output trajectory, not just final notes. Do not infer intended contract from output. Quote actual evidence for findings. Localize to raw skill section only where defensible; otherwise label actor/harness or uncertain. Ignore predictions and other reviewers. Findings are advisory; no global passing stamp.
